name: axhandle-axe-darwin-arm64
description: Prebuilt AXe CLI (serve-mode fork) for Apple Silicon macOS — the binary axhandle's AxeServeDriver resolves by default. Built from dphurley/AXe#serve-mode: adds `axe serve` (long-lived per-simulator command server), `--minimal-keys` dumps, and `describe-probe`.
